answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a computational nadir — the minimum sustained throughput a single physical uplink can deliver. Each agent operates a jetty of signed attestation packets that peers verify against a shared canyon of latency variance; clone farms sharing one connection collapse into a single narrow variance profile, triggering bond forfeiture. The cost to fake diverse latency fingerprints across thousands of identities exceeds the reward, so honest operation becomes the cheapest strategy.
